layout_structure.title_text: MonSter: Marry Monodepth to Stereo Unleashes Power
layout_structure.layout_description: The slide follows a centered, single-column layout typical of a presentation title page. At the top, the main title is written in a large, bold serif font, with the letters 'Mon' and 'Ster' highlighted in red to emphasize the acronym. Directly below the title is a subtitle 'CVPR 2025 Highlight' in a large, red, italicized font. The middle section contains a list of ten authors arranged in two centered rows. Below the authors, a GitHub URL is provided. The bottom of the slide features three logos aligned horizontally: the circular seal of Huazhong University of Science and Technology on the left, the Autel Robotics logo in the center, and the Intel logo on the right. The background is plain white, and the text density is light, creating a clean and professional appearance.

The slide uses a clean, single-column layout with a bold, black title 'Our contribution:' positioned at the top-left. Below the title, there are two bullet points that highlight key achievements, with specific phrases like 'best accuracy and generalization' and 'Ranks 1st' emphasized in red text. The lower half of the slide features a large, centered radar chart (spider plot) that is somewhat faint in appearance. This chart compares the performance of the proposed 'MonSter' model against several other methods (Los, IGEV, CREStereo, NMRF-Stereo, Selective-IGEV) across five benchmarks: Sceneflow (EPE), KITTI 15 (D1-bg), Middlebury (RMSE), ETH3D (Bad 1.0), and KITTI 12 (Out-3). A legend for the chart is located in the bottom-right corner, with the 'MonSter (Ours)' entry highlighted in red to match the bullet point emphasis. The overall text density is light, set against a plain white background.

The slide features a large bold title positioned at the top-left corner. The main content is organized vertically into two sections. The top section consists of two side-by-side photographic images of a parking lot scene, labeled 'Left Image' and 'Right Image' centered above each. Below these, a single large figure spans the full width of the slide, displaying a color-coded depth map corresponding to the scene above. This depth map is labeled 'Metric Depth' at the bottom center and uses a heatmap color scheme where yellow/orange indicates proximity and purple/blue indicates distance. The background is plain white, and the text density is very light, focusing entirely on qualitative visual results.

The slide uses a figure-based layout on a clean white background to showcase qualitative results. A bold, black title is located at the top-left corner. The central content is organized into two rows of images. The top row features two side-by-side photographs of a street scene, labeled 'Left Image' and 'Right Image' with centered text above each. Below these, a single large image occupies the bottom half of the slide, showing a color-coded depth map (heatmap) corresponding to the scene above. This large figure is labeled 'Metric Depth' at the bottom center. The color scheme of the depth map transitions from bright yellow for near objects to deep purple for distant ones. The slide has very light text density, focusing entirely on the visual comparison between input stereo images and the generated depth output.

The slide features a large, bold title positioned at the top-left corner. The main content consists of three images arranged in a grid-like fashion. The top row contains two side-by-side photographs of an indoor scene, individually labeled 'Left Image' and 'Right Image' centered above each. These images show a room with a ping-pong table, chairs, and people in the background. Occupying the bottom half of the slide is a single, large image labeled 'Metric Depth' at the bottom center. This image is a color-coded depth map corresponding to the scene above, utilizing a vibrant color gradient from bright yellow in the foreground to deep purple in the background. The slide has a clean white background with very light text density, primarily focusing on the visual qualitative results.

The slide has a clean white background with no bullet points or additional text, resulting in a very light text density focused on qualitative visual results.

layout_structure.title_text: Zero-Shot Performance comparison in the wild
layout_structure.layout_description: The slide uses a horizontal comparison layout to showcase qualitative results. A bold, serif title is located at the top-left corner. The main content consists of a single row of five images. The first image on the left is a standard RGB photograph labeled 'Left Image'. This is followed by four depth maps rendered as rainbow-colored heatmaps (where red indicates closer objects and blue indicates further ones). Each depth map is labeled below with its corresponding model name and publication venue: 'CREStereo (CVPR'22)', 'CroCo v2 (ICCV'23)', 'IGEV (CVPR'23)', and 'Ours'. The 'Ours' label is distinguished by its red font color. Red circles are overlaid on the same region in each of the four depth maps to draw attention to performance differences in a specific area of the scene. The overall design is clean with a white background and light text density.

layout_structure.title_text: Zero-Shot Performance comparison in the wild
layout_structure.layout_description: The slide uses a horizontal comparison layout to showcase qualitative results. A bold, black title is positioned at the top-left corner. Below the title, five images are arranged side-by-side in a single row. The first image on the left is a real-world photograph labeled 'Left Image', depicting an indoor building interior with multiple levels and railings. The following four images are depth map visualizations (heatmaps) corresponding to the same scene, each labeled below with its respective model name: 'CREStereo (CVPR'22)', 'CroCo v2 (ICCV'23)', 'IGEV (CVPR'23)', and 'Ours'. The 'Ours' label is highlighted in red to distinguish the proposed method. The heatmaps use a color scale where blue represents distant areas and red/yellow represents near objects, specifically highlighting the foreground railing. The background is plain white, and the text density is light, prioritizing visual comparison over textual explanation.

The slide follows a simple, centered single-column layout on a plain white background. A large, bold title is positioned at the top center. Below the title, two lines of text are vertically stacked in the middle of the slide, each consisting of a label ('Project page:' and 'Code repository:') followed by a blue, underlined hyperlink. At the bottom, a single sentence of text is centered, announcing future work.
